WITH per_id AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM per_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE share > average_share
